profile.headline: Software Engineer at Truist
profile.summary: Dynamic and results-driven software engineer with extensive experience in leading development teams and delivering high-quality database applications. Specialized in SQL, ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, and MVC architecture, with a proven track record of fostering collaboration and mentoring team members. Adept at managing projects from conception to execution while ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Recognized for effectively troubleshooting issues and implementing innovative solutions. Committed to continuous improvement and leveraging technology to drive efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Corpus Christi, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description: Developing internal client/server based applications with the following languages: ASP Classic, ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, SQL, and GIT. Using Agile project management and serving as a Release Manager.

positions.title: Intranet Support Manager
positions.description: Managed the Intranet Support team while also working as a developer for the team.

projects.title: Capstone Project-Mobile Application Development
projects.description: This ePortfolio site represents a sample of how I can build a site to showcase a piece of work from conception to execution. I developed a mobile application called "Weight and See" which tracks weight entered against a goal. With only 2 months to complete the project, I built a working application using Android Studio with Room Library/SQLLite database backend.
